text:
alex: Quickfire morning check-in — what I did: landed microbatch fairness fix (PR #4321) and ran KV warmup perf across 2 canaries; median p50 token latency down ~7%. Blockers: intermittent OOM on slot-3 when BATCH_SIZE > 64, happens ~1/200 runs. Today: roll a small canary of patched allocator + dig into eviction heuristics.

maria: Nice! Can you share the OOM stacktrace and the exact alloc settings you used? Also did you test with the new kv-prefetch flag toggled?

sam: I repro'd locally with a stress harness — looks like a small slot leak when `continuous_batching=true` + `max_batch_size=128`. Heap grows until oom on ~180s. Reproduction snippet: `python tests/stress/run_load.py --workers 8 --seq-len 1024 --batch 128`

jing: Pushed a tentative hotfix to allocator branch (allocator-v2) that zeroes stale slot pointers after evict. Added a unit test that simulates our slot churn. Can push a canary if you want me to.

alex: @jing yes please canary that. Attaching the relevant oom excerpt: ```
E heap: allocation failed: OutOfMemoryError at slot=3
  trace: runtime/slot_manager.cpp:412
  alloc_size=2.8G free=1.9G
  config: continuous_batching=true max_batch_size=128 kv_prefetch=true
```

maria: Also saw a small bump in tail lat for long seqs on node-2 during your run. Might be related to the prefetch + batch coalescing window. Suggest we try lowering `coalesce_ms` to 2ms in canary.

sam: FWIW I saw the same repro only when `kv_cache.size_per_slot=256MB`. If we reduce to 128MB issue disappears but perf regresses ~3%. Tradeoff to evaluate.

jing: Canary deploy queued. @deploy-bot can you start allocator-v2 canary on pool `gpu-p2` with 5% traffic and `coalesce_ms=2`?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary initiated for allocator-v2 on pool gpu-p2 — targets: 5% traffic, env overrides: {"coalesce_ms":"2","kv_cache.size_per_slot":"192MB"}. Status: in_progress. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) if canary looks stable by noon I'll promote and run a full 2-node perf sweep; (2) @sam can you run the stress harness with the `192MB` setting and paste latency diffs; (3) I'll open a short runbook entry for the OOM signal so oncall can triage faster.

maria: acked, I'll watch canary metrics and post any anomalies here.

sam: will run and report in ~45m.

jing: monitoring synthetic warmup and kv hits; will flag if eviction spikes.

alex: great — that's it for my quickfire. :coffee:
